title: Shortly — URL Shortener
summary: A full-stack URL shortener with accounts, click analytics and background jobs.
highlights: Express API with JWT auth and a separate BullMQ worker for email and analytics jobs
MongoDB for links and users, Redis for queues
Dockerised full-stack setup; frontend on Vercel, API on Render

title: Collaborative Whiteboard
summary: A real-time whiteboard where several users draw on the same canvas at once.
highlights: Live drawing sync between users over Socket.IO
Accounts with JWT + bcrypt, boards persisted in MongoDB
Export a board to PDF with jsPDF

title: Code Judge — Evaluator & Problem Services
summary: Microservices for an online-judge platform: one manages problems, the other evaluates submissions through a job queue.
highlights: Evaluator in TypeScript: BullMQ + Redis queue with a Bull Board dashboard, zod-validated payloads
Problem service: Express + MongoDB, Markdown problem statements sanitised before storage
Structured logging with Winston shipped to MongoDB

title: myTube — Video Platform Backend
summary: The backend for a video streaming app: uploads, users and paginated feeds.
highlights: Video and thumbnail uploads via Multer to Cloudinary
Access/refresh-token auth with JWT and bcrypt
Aggregation pipelines with pagination for feeds and channel stats

title: Movie Booking Service
summary: A BookMyShow-style backend for movies, theatres and bookings.
highlights: REST API for movies, theatres and bookings

title: Appwrite Blog
summary: A blogging app using Appwrite as a backend-as-a-service, with a rich-text editor.
highlights: Forms with react-hook-form, state with Redux Toolkit
